title: Sword for Your Next Tinder Date
tagline: When 'Netflix and chill' just isn't cutting it, upgrade to 'Katana and thrill'. Perfect for impressing your date by demonstrating your ability to dismember a watermelon with precision—or at least your willingness to try. Bonus points if you can explain why you own a samurai sword while ordering takeout.

title: Fingerprint Fidelity
tagline: For the couple who wants to leave their mark—literally. Perfect for that romantic evening where you're both locked out of your apartment and need to prove you're not just some rando trying to break in. The ultimate 'I do' for those who believe love is in the details... or at least the ridges.

title: Divorce Therapy in a Box
tagline: When your spouse says 'we need to talk,' hand them this puzzle instead. Perfect for passive-aggressively piecing together your relationship's downfall—one fragmented memory at a time. Bonus: It doubles as a metaphor for your marriage.

title: Tiny Tippers for Tiny Sippers
tagline: Because nothing says 'I take my drinking seriously' like a miniature flip cup for your dollhouse bar. Perfect for those nights when you're practicing your beer pong skills alone in your studio apartment, or when your cat needs to feel included in your social life. Comes with a tiny coaster, because even at 1/12th scale, you're not a monster.

title: Aquatic Crown for Landlocked Dreams
tagline: For when your bathtub fantasies need a touch of royal delusion. Perfect for that one friend who insists their 'oceanic connection' is why they can't leave their apartment. Comes with a free side of 'I should've bought a snorkel instead' regret.

title: Wubba Lubba Dub Mask
tagline: For the one friend who still quotes Rick and Morty at parties, this 3D printed mask is a conversation starter. Wear it to a family reunion to really make Grandma question your life choices.

title: Galaxy in a Can
tagline: For when your date says 'let's go stargazing' but you live in a city where the only visible celestial body is a flickering neon sign. This projector turns your ceiling into a cheap facsimile of the cosmos—no light pollution, no actual stars, just the comforting glow of plastic. Perfect for convincing your cat that the room is suddenly space.

title: Lucky Break Handbag
tagline: For when you need a purse that's as unpredictable as your love life, this fortune cookie bag brings a message with every open. Use it to smuggle snacks into the movies or as a conversation starter at your aunt's birthday party.

title: Drinkware Fireworks
tagline: Because your house party needs more '90s rave nostalgia. Light these up when your guests ask for the third time if you're *sure* there's no more booze left. Watch as they're distracted by the sparkly spectacle, giving you precious seconds to Google 'how to make vodka from potatoes.'

title: Zombie Survival Guide Sticker
tagline: Because when the undead rise, the last thing you'll regret is not having a wall decal. Perfect for that one friend who insists on being prepared for the apocalypse—just slap this on their bathroom mirror so they can practice their zombie escape plan while brushing their teeth.

title: Banana Republic Rebellion
tagline: For when your toddler’s villainous phase demands a plush accomplice. Perfect for staging tiny heists on your snack drawer or negotiating with the family dog for treats. Comes with a built-in ‘evil laugh’ setting—just shake vigorously. Warning: May inspire impromptu banana thefts.

title: Beer Me, Shower
tagline: For when you need a cold one to survive a 6am shower, this holder's got you covered. Because, priorities.

title: Bricks of Justice
tagline: For when your toddler's imaginary heist requires a sidearm. This LEGO Desert Eagle is the perfect accessory for their next 'Operation: Take Back the Crayons' mission. Just don't be surprised if they start negotiating for a higher ransom in Duplo.

title: Wear the Night Sky on Your Lobes
tagline: Forget matching your earrings to your outfit—match them to the cosmos instead. These constellation earrings are perfect for the astrology enthusiast who wants to subtly signal their alignment with the stars while waiting in line at the DMV. Because nothing says 'I’m a Virgo' like a tiny Orion’s Belt dangling from your ear.

title: Sneaky Snack Swords
tagline: For when you need to stealthily eat corn at a medieval themed dinner party, these ninja sword corn skewers are oddly practical.

title: Tusk in Your Hand
tagline: For when your morning coffee needs a dash of Arctic whimsy. Perfect for marine biologists who moonlight as baristas, or that one friend who insists narwhals are just unicorns of the sea. Bonus: The tusk doubles as a stir stick for your existential crisis.

title: Pizza Buddies: Wearable Carb Bonding
tagline: For when your friendship is as cheesy as a late-night delivery. Perfect for splitting a slice while silently judging each other’s toppings choices. Comes in two halves—because even your BFF deserves their own crust. Ideal for pizza parties where the only thing getting shared is the awkwardness of deciding who gets the last piece.

title: Tiny You, Huge Regret.
tagline: Finally, a way to immortalize your crippling student loan debt! For a mere $3,500, you can get a miniature version of yourself, perfect for staging elaborate reenactments of your therapy sessions. Think of the possibilities! Is it practical? Absolutely not. Will you weep silently as you realize you could have used this money for, like, *food*? Guaranteed.

title: Simpsons: Undead Edition
tagline: For when your love of The Simpsons has outlasted its cultural relevance. Perfect for that friend who still quotes 'Allo, 'Allo! unironically. Display these on your desk at work to subtly remind your boss that you've been here since the '90s and still haven't gotten that promotion.

title: TP for Your Darkroom
tagline: Because your bathroom needed a dash of nostalgia, this Polaroid camera toilet paper holder is perfect for when you're trying to develop a sense of humor while on the throne.

title: Gremlins After Dark
tagline: For when your tiki bar needs a little more '80s chaos. These mugs are perfect for that one friend who insists on telling the story of how they once saw a gremlin in a Hawaiian shirt. Comes with a side of nostalgia and a hint of mischief—just don't get them wet or feed them after midnight.

title: Fungal Glow for Midnight Snackers
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm still awake at 3 AM' like a mushroom-shaped nightlight. Perfect for those who've given up on sleep and now just stare at their fridge, debating whether to eat the questionable leftovers. The soft glow won't wake your partner, but your midnight munching might.

title: Desktop Zen... of DOOM?
tagline: Is your office lacking that *one* thing to really unnerve visiting clients? Behold: a tiny automated sandbox endlessly drawing unsettling patterns. Perfect for silently judging colleagues' presentation skills, or just contemplating the inevitable heat death of the universe during a particularly dull Zoom meeting. Batteries not included (because the void has no need for Duracell).

title: Cogwork Claws for Your Quirky Renaissance Fair
tagline: When your LARP character needs to pick up a sword without breaking character, these wooden mechanical hands are here to save the day. Perfect for the medieval cosplayer who refuses to compromise their aesthetic, even when reaching for a snack. Just don't expect them to help you tie your shoes.

title: Bone-Chilling Ice Skulls
tagline: For when your whiskey needs a side of existential dread. Perfect for that late-night séance where the spirits are strong—but your drinks could use a little more *spooky*. Silicone skulls that won’t haunt your freezer (but might haunt your guests).

title: Punch Pass: The Rage Journal
tagline: For those moments when your neighbor's leaf blower is the soundtrack to your Sunday morning, or your coworker's 'just checking in' email is the 12th of the hour. This book is your legal, non-violent outlet for all the faces you'd like to punch—metaphorically, of course. Perfect for therapy sessions, road rage, or that one family dinner where Uncle Bob won't stop talking about his 'investments.'

title: Taxidermy for the Fiscally Responsible
tagline: For when your landlord won’t let you mount a real deer head, but you still want to impress your vegan book club. These paper animal trophies are the perfect blend of irony and crafting—like a DIY project for people who think 'IKEA' is a personality trait. Bonus: No guilt when your cat knocks it off the wall.

title: Glowing Greetings for Night Owls
tagline: For when your late-night pizza delivery guy needs to know you're home but you're too lazy to turn on the porch light. This neon 'Hello' sign is the lazy man's beacon, ensuring your 3 AM cheese fix arrives without you having to lift a finger. Perfect for those who consider 'socializing' as waving at the mailman from behind the blinds.

title: The 'I Did It' Button
tagline: For when your victory lap deserves a soundtrack. Press it after finally folding that mountain of laundry, or when you outsmart the office coffee machine. The 'Yassss' button—because sometimes, the only appropriate response to your own brilliance is a dramatic, button-activated affirmation.

title: Jake's Neck Cradle
tagline: For when you need a stretchy dog's face to support your neck during a 3am Netflix binge, because priorities.

title: Elfcore Claw for Your FOMO
tagline: Because your medieval LARP character needs a *little* more edge. Perfect for when you're roleplaying an elf who moonlights as a cat burglar, or just want to intimidate your DM into giving you better loot. Bonus: doubles as a fancy letter opener for your Dungeon Master’s resignation note.

title: Blobfish of Despair
tagline: For when you've hit rock bottom, this blobfish plush is the perfect companion. It's like having a cuddly manifestation of your existential crisis, but softer.

title: Rubber Band Rampage
tagline: For when you need to silently annoy coworkers, this 1911 rubber band gun is oddly perfect. Load it up and launch a stealthy office supply attack.

title: Canine Colon: A Year Long Saga
tagline: Is your meticulously curated gallery wall missing… something? Perhaps a celebration of canine digestive regularity? This calendar ensures you'll never be caught off guard again by the cyclical nature of a dog's… business. Perfect for timing fertilizer applications, or just confusing the heck out of your houseguests.

title: Goose Your Keys
tagline: For when you need a bird to judge you for losing your keys, this goose key holder is perfect for the friend who still can't find their apartment keys after a year of living there.

title: Brick by Brick, Your Style
tagline: For when you need to carry your essentials to a LEGO convention but also want to subtly remind everyone that you're an adult with a mortgage. This purse is the perfect blend of childhood nostalgia and 'I could have bought a used car for this price.' Ideal for those moments when you're at a wine tasting and suddenly feel the urge to build a tiny castle.

title: Bros, Meet Your New Wingman
tagline: For when your hands are full of nachos, your friends are full of opinions, and your fridge is full of unopened beers. This six-pack opener is the silent hero of tailgates, ensuring you never have to pause your argument about whether pineapple belongs on pizza just to crack a cold one. Perfect for the guy who multitasks like a champ—holding a baby in one arm, a burger in the other, and still needs to open a beer.

title: Nirvana in a Box
tagline: For the true fan who's ever wanted to reenact Kurt's haunting melodies at a dinner party, this replica guitar is a conversation starter – or a relationship ender.

title: Hands-Free Happy Hour
tagline: For when your third beer is finally loosening your inhibitions, but your second beer has already loosened your belt. This is the only way to maintain dignity while still holding a cold one in each hand. Perfect for tailgating with your arms full of snacks or when you need to free up a hand to high-five your buddy after he nails that 3-pointer on the driveway hoop.

title: Ye Olde Booze Goblets
tagline: For when your Dungeons & Dragons campaign needs a little more authenticity. Sip your +5 potion (or just whiskey) from these tiny, ornate cups. Perfect for LARPing, Renaissance fairs, or convincing your friends you're actually a medieval noble. Just don't try to summon a dragon with them—it's not that kind of magic.

title: T-Rex Tea Rings
tagline: For the paleontologist who refuses to use a napkin. These coasters turn your coffee rings into Cretaceous artifacts. Perfect for that awkward dinner party where your date’s ex shows up—now you can subtly remind them you’re a survivor of the great extinction event.

title: Ho-Ho-Hold My Lightsaber!
tagline: Finally, a way to settle those awkward Christmas dinner arguments. Uncle Jerry still ranting about politics? *Whack!* Now he's just unconscious and covered in festive red and green plasma. Because nothing says 'peace on Earth' like a $450 glowing stick that'll leave you eating ramen for the next three months. Merry freakin' Christmas to your empty bank account.

title: Trophy for Trying (And Failing)
tagline: Perfect for the office 'Most Likely to Get Stuck in the Printer' award or the family member who somehow burns toast every time. These ribbons celebrate the art of coming in last with style. Because sometimes, being the worst is an achievement in itself.

title: Noodle Sword Mastery
tagline: For that one pool party where things get medieval, this foam sword is oddly practical. Imagine settling a heated game of Marco Polo with a noodle duel – it's a thing now.
